10-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (72-bet) - GRAMMATIKA.

Yuqorida chapda YaShIL yorliqda oq '10' va 'Stick to the Rules!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Might/Could'. OCh KO'K quti 'Use': 'We use MIGHT or COULD to say that it is possible that something will happen. Stay away from the dog. It MIGHT/COULD bite you.'
9) 'Match the prompts to the people in the picture, then say what might/could happen.' Katakchali: 1 hit/child 2 fall out of/tree 3 cut/foot 4 fall into/hole 5 fall into/pond/drown. Ko'k qiya: 'Bob might hit the child.'
   SURAT (chizma): ko'cha; A Bob - ko'k mashina haydamoqda, oldida yo'lda bola (to'p bilan); B Chris - yashil futbolkada ochiq lyuk (hole) tomon yugurmoqda; C Tom - qizil futbolkada daraxtga chiqqan; D Don - ko'k kepkada yalangoyoq yugurmoqda, oldida singan shisha; E Stuart - sariq futbolkada hovuz chekkasida muvozanat saqlamoqda.
10) 'Match the warnings to the results, then ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Binafsha quti 'FIRE PRECAUTIONS': Warnings: 1 play with burning candles (✗) 2 smoke in bed (✗) 3 be careful when cooking with hot oil (✓) 4 fit a smoke alarm (✓) 5 have a fire extinguisher in your house (✓). Results (katakchali): a you/stop a small fire; b it/warn you of a fire in your house; c [1] you/start a fire; d you/fall asleep and set the house on fire; e it/catch fire. Ko'k qiya: SA: Never play with burning candles. SB: Why? SA: You might start a fire.

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Use the information from Ex. 10 to write a leaflet about fire precautions. Use the leaflet in Ex. 3 as a model. Use always, never, make sure, etc.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Have to/don't have to - Must/mustn't'. OCh KO'K quti 'Use': • 'We use HAVE TO to express necessity. You HAVE TO buy a ticket before getting on the train.' • 'We use DO NOT HAVE TO to say that it is not necessary for something to happen. You DON'T HAVE TO help me wash the car. (... but you can if you want to.)' • 'We can use MUST/MUSTN'T to express very strong advice. You MUST stay away from the boats. (It's very important that you stay away from the boats.) You MUSTN'T go near the rocks. (It's very important that you don't go near the rocks.)' • 'We also use MUSTN'T to express prohibition. You MUSTN'T steal from other people. (It's illegal.)'
11) a) Kasseta belgisi: qiya 'Anne goes to a boarding school in England. Chris goes to high school in America.' 'Read the prompts, then listen and put a tick (✓) or a cross (✗) in each column. Finally, write sentences as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: 'Chris has to get up early to catch the school bus.' TO'Q SARIQ JADVAL 'Who has to ...' | Chris | Anne: get up early to catch the school bus? ✓ ✗ (tayyor); wear a school uniform?; stay in the school grounds at lunchtime?; go to lessons on Saturday mornings?; clean the classroom?
    b) 'What about you? Ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: SA: Do you have to get up early to catch the school bus? SB: No, I don't. Do you have to wear a school uniform?
12) 'Using information from the leaflet on p. 71, make sentences giving advice to parents. Use MUST/MUSTN'T, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: 'You MUST keep all cleaning products in a safe place.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '72'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MIGHT va COULD - EhTIMOL.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = ... bo'lishi MUMKIN (ehtimol).
  'Stay away from the dog. It
   MIGHT/COULD bite you.'
  (tishlashi mumkin - aniq emas)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  might/could + FE'L (to SIZ)
  ⚠ Barcha shaxsda bir xil.
  ⚠ 'might to bite' - XATO!

  INKOR: might not (mightn't) /
     could not (couldn't)


⚠ 'MIGHT' va 'MAY':

  Ikkalasi ehtimol; 'may' biroz
  kuchliroq (50%), 'might' kamroq
  (30%).


⚠ 'COULD' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) ehtimol: 'It could rain.'
  2) o'tmishdagi 'can': 'I could
     swim when I was five.'
  ⚠ Kontekst ochib beradi.


⚠ 'STAY AWAY FROM':

  = ... dan uzoq turmoq.

points.en: We use might or could to say that it is possible that something will happen.
points.uz: 'might' yoki 'could' ni biror narsa bo'lishi mumkinligini aytish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: Stay away from the dog. It might/could bite you.
points.uz: Itdan uzoq tur. U seni tishlashi mumkin.

exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni suratdagi odamlarga moslang, so'ng nima bo'lishi mumkinligini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh BOLA - BESh XAVF.

  1 hit/child → A Bob (mashina
    haydayapti, oldida bola)
  2 fall out of/tree → C Tom
    (daraxtda)
  3 cut/foot → D Don (yalangoyoq,
    singan shisha)
  4 fall into/hole → B Chris (ochiq
    lyuk tomon yugurmoqda)
  5 fall into/pond/drown → E Stuart
    (hovuz chekkasida)

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Bob might hit the child.'


⚠ 'TO FALL OUT OF':

  = ... dan tushib ketmoq (daraxt,
  deraza).


⚠ 'TO FALL INTO':

  = ... ichiga tushmoq (chuqur,
  hovuz).

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Bob mashina haydayapti, oldida to'pli bola.

modelAnswers: Tom could fall out of the tree.
Chris could fall into the hole.
Stuart might fall into the pond and drown.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the warnings to the results.
exercises.explanationUz:
YoNG'IN XAVFSIZLIGI.

  1 play with burning candles (✗)
    → c you/start a fire (tayyor)
  2 smoke in bed (✗) → d you/fall
    asleep and set the house on fire
  3 be careful when cooking with
    hot oil (✓) → e it/catch fire
  4 fit a smoke alarm (✓) → b
    it/warn you of a fire
  5 have a fire extinguisher (✓) →
    a you/stop a small fire


⚠ '✗' va '✓':

  ✗ = QILMANG (Never ...)
  ✓ = QILING (Always ...)


⚠ 'PRECAUTIONS':

  = ehtiyot choralari.
  ⚠ 'to take precautions' = ehtiyot
  chorasini ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'A SMOKE ALARM':

  = tutun signalizatsiyasi.


⚠ 'A FIRE EXTINGUISHER':

  = o't o'chirgich.
  ⚠ 'to extinguish' = o'chirmoq.


⚠ 'TO SET ON FIRE' va 'TO CATCH
  FIRE':

  set sth on fire = yoqib yubormoq
     (kimdir)
  catch fire = yonib ketmoq (o'zi)


⚠ 'TO WARN SB OF':

  = kimnidir ... dan ogohlantirmoq.

pairs.right: d you/fall asleep and set the house on fire

pairs.left: 3 be careful when cooking with hot oil (✓)

pairs.right: b it/warn you of a fire in your house

pairs.left: 5 have a fire extinguisher in your house (✓)

  ✗ → Never + fe'l. Why? You
     might/could ...

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from Ex. 10 to write a leaflet about fire precautions. Use the leaflet in Ex. 3 as a model. Use always, never, make sure, etc.
exercises.instructionUz: 10-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib yong'in xavfsizligi haqida varaqa yozing. 3-mashqdagi varaqadan namuna sifatida foydalaning. always, never, make sure va h.k. ishlating.
exercises.explanationUz:
LOYIhA TOPShIRIG'I.

⚠ NAMUNA VARAQA:

  FIRE PRECAUTIONS
  • Never play with burning candles.
    You might start a fire.
  • Never smoke in bed. You could
    fall asleep and set the house on
    fire.
  • Always be careful when cooking
    with hot oil. It might catch
    fire.
  • Make sure you fit a smoke alarm.
    It could warn you of a fire in
    your house.
  • Always have a fire extinguisher
    in your house. You might stop a
    small fire.

points.en: Never play with burning candles. You might start a fire.
points.uz: Yonayotgan sham bilan hech qachon o'ynamang. Yong'in chiqarishingiz mumkin.

points.en: Never smoke in bed. You could fall asleep and set the house on fire.
points.uz: Yotoqda hech qachon chekmang. Uxlab qolib uyni yoqib yuborishingiz mumkin.

points.en: Always be careful when cooking with hot oil. It might catch fire.
points.uz: Qaynoq yog'da pishirganda har doim ehtiyot bo'ling. U yonib ketishi mumkin.

points.en: Make sure you fit a smoke alarm. It could warn you of a fire in your house.
points.uz: Tutun signalizatsiyasi o'rnatganingizga ishonch hosil qiling. U sizni uyingizdagi yong'indan ogohlantirishi mumkin.

points.en: Always have a fire extinguisher in your house. You might stop a small fire.
points.uz: Uyingizda har doim o't o'chirgich bo'lsin. Kichik yong'inni to'xtatishingiz mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Have to/don't have to - Must/mustn't — Use
exercises.instructionUz: Have to/don't have to - Must/mustn't — Ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJBURIYaT VA TAQIQ.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HAVE TO = ZARURAT               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'You HAVE TO buy a ticket before
   getting on the train.'
  ⚠ Tashqi qoida, zarurat.
  ⚠ he/she/it → HAS TO.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  DON'T HAVE TO = ShART EMAS      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "You DON'T HAVE TO help me wash
   the car." (xohlasang - qilasan)
  ⚠ TAQIQ EMAS! Faqat 'kerak emas'.
  ⚠ he/she → DOESN'T HAVE TO.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUST = JUDA KUChLI MASLAHAT     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'You MUST stay away from the
   boats.' (juda muhim)
  ⚠ Gapiruvchining O'Z fikri.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUSTN'T = TAQIQ                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "You MUSTN'T go near the rocks."
  (juda muhim - bormaslik)
  "You MUSTN'T steal." (qonun
   taqiqlaydi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG KATTA XATO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DON'T HAVE TO ≠ MUSTN'T

  "You don't have to come." =
     kelishing shart emas (xohlasang
     kel)
  "You mustn't come." = kelma!
     (taqiq)

  ⚠ O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham 'kerak
  emas' deb tarjima qilinishi
  mumkin - DIQQAT!


⚠ 'MUST' O'TGAN ZAMONI YO'Q:

  → 'had to' ishlatiladi.
  'I HAD TO buy a ticket yesterday.'


⚠ 'ILLEGAL':

  = noqonuniy.
  ⚠ 'legal' = qonuniy.


⚠ 'PROHIBITION':

  = taqiq.

points.en: We use have to to express necessity. You have to buy a ticket before getting on the train.
points.uz: 'have to' ni zaruratni ifodalash uchun ishlatamiz. Poyezdga chiqishdan oldin chipta sotib olishingiz kerak.

points.en: We use do not have to to say that it is not necessary for something to happen. You don't have to help me wash the car. (... but you can if you want to.)
points.uz: 'do not have to' ni biror narsa zarur emasligini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Mashina yuvishga yordam berishing shart emas. (... lekin xohlasang, bo'ladi.)

points.en: We can use must/mustn't to express very strong advice. You must stay away from the boats. You mustn't go near the rocks.
points.uz: 'must/mustn't' ni juda kuchli maslahat uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin. Qayiqlardan uzoq turishingiz shart. Qoyalarga yaqin bormasligingiz shart.

points.en: We also use mustn't to express prohibition. You mustn't steal from other people. (It's illegal.)
points.uz: 'mustn't' ni taqiqni ifodalash uchun ham ishlatamiz. Boshqalardan o'g'irlik qilish mumkin emas. (Bu noqonuniy.)

exercises.instructionEn: Anne goes to a boarding school in England. Chris goes to high school in America. Read the prompts, then listen and put a tick (✓) or a cross (✗) in each column. Finally, write sentences as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Anne Angliyadagi internat maktabga boradi. Chris Amerikadagi o'rta maktabga boradi. Ko'rsatmalarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va har ustunga ✓ yoki ✗ qo'ying. Nihoyat, namunadagidek gaplar yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - jadval yozuvdan
to'ldiriladi. Birinchi qator kitobda
tayyor.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Chris HAS TO get up early to catch
   the school bus.'


JADVAL 'Who has to ...':

  get up early to catch the school
    bus? - Chris ✓, Anne ✗ (tayyor)
  wear a school uniform? - ?
  stay in the school grounds at
    lunchtime? - ?
  go to lessons on Saturday
    mornings? - ?
  clean the classroom? - ?


⚠ GAP QOLIPLARI:

  ✓ → [Ism] HAS TO ...
  ✗ → [Ism] DOESN'T HAVE TO ...

  'Anne doesn't have to get up early
   to catch the school bus.'


⚠ 'A BOARDING SCHOOL':

  = internat maktab (o'quvchilar
  yashaydi).


⚠ 'HIGH SCHOOL':

  = o'rta maktab (AQSh, 14-18 yosh).


⚠ 'SCHOOL GROUNDS':

  = maktab hududi.

points.en: Chris has to get up early to catch the school bus. Anne doesn't have to get up early to catch the school bus.
points.uz: Chris maktab avtobusiga ulgurish uchun erta turishi kerak. Anne maktab avtobusiga ulgurish uchun erta turishi shart emas.

points.en: stay in the school grounds at lunchtime?
go to lessons on Saturday mornings?

exercises.instructionEn: What about you? Ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Do you have to get up early to
      catch the school bus?
  SB: No, I don't. Do you have to
      wear a school uniform?


⚠ SAVOL:

  DO you HAVE TO ...?
  ⚠ 'Have you to ...?' - XATO
  (eskirgan).


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
  ⚠ 'Yes, I have' - XATO ('have to'
  oddiy fe'l kabi).

items.question: SA: Do you have to get up early to catch the school bus?
SB: Do you have to wear a school uniform?
SA: Do you have to stay in the school grounds at lunchtime?
SB: Do you have to go to lessons on Saturday mornings?
SA: Do you have to clean the classroom?

exercises.instructionEn: Using information from the leaflet on p. 71, make sentences giving advice to parents. Use must/mustn't, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: 71-betdagi varaqadagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib ota-onalarga maslahat beruvchi gaplar tuzing. must/mustn't ni ishlating, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'You MUST keep all cleaning
   products in a safe place.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  buyruq (tasdiq) → You MUST ...
  buyruq (inkor: Never) → You
     MUSTN'T ...


⚠ 'MUSTN'T' O'QILIShI:

  /ˈmʌsnt/ - birinchi 't'
  O'QILMAYDI.
exercises.exampleEn: You must keep all cleaning products in a safe place.
exercises.exampleUz: Barcha tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlashingiz shart.
modelAnswers: You must keep all cleaning products in a safe place.
You must put knives and other sharp objects away after use.
You mustn't allow your children to play with pots and pans on the stove.
You must cover electrical sockets when they are not in use.
You mustn't let your children play with matches.
You must fit safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs.
You must put a fence around any ponds or pools in your garden.
modelAnswersUz: Barcha tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlashingiz shart.
Pichoq va boshqa o'tkir narsalarni ishlatgandan keyin joyiga qo'yishingiz shart.
Bolalaringizga plitadagi qozon-tovalar bilan o'ynashga ruxsat bermasligingiz shart.
Bolalaringizni gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymasligingiz shart.
Zinaning yuqori va pastki qismiga xavfsizlik to'siqlarini o'rnatishingiz shart.
Bog'ingizdagi har qanday hovuz yoki basseyn atrofiga panjara qo'yishingiz shart.

patterns.exampleEn: Tom could fall out of the tree.

patterns.formula: Never/Always + FE'L. - Why? - You might + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Never play with burning candles. - Why? - You might start a fire.
patterns.exampleUz: Yonayotgan sham bilan hech qachon o'ynama. - Nega? - Yong'in chiqarishing mumkin.

patterns.formula: [Ega] has to / doesn't have to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Chris has to get up early. Anne doesn't have to wear a uniform.
patterns.exampleUz: Chris erta turishi kerak. Anne forma kiyishi shart emas.

patterns.formula: Do you have to + FE'L? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
patterns.exampleEn: Do you have to wear a school uniform? - No, I don't.
You must keep cleaning products in a safe place. You mustn't let children play with matches.
patterns.exampleUz: Tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlashingiz shart. Bolalarni gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymasligingiz shart.
